text:
Jules: Heads up — onboarding a community model (hf://someuser/cool-chat) hit a weird safetensors failure. Index fetched OK but shard 4/12 failed checksum during conversion. The converter then retried without the pinned revision and we ended up with weight key renames that broke the loader. Anyone seen index -> safetensors shard ordering or rev-pin issues?

Arun: ugh. did you pin a revision in the converter config? the converter should pass ?revision=... to the HF api. can you paste the logs? @Sasha FYI.

Jules: I pinned revision "v2.1-quant". converter logs show HTTP 200 for index.json then GET /file-00004.safetensors -> 200 but checksum mismatch: "expected abc123, got def456". snippet from converter log:
```json
{"error":"checksum_mismatch","shard":"00004","expected":"abc123","got":"def456"}
```

Marta: Could be a partial shard upload on HF's side, or CDN serving an old shard. Also worth noting: we recently had a bug where we reconstructed the shard list from index.json and sorted lexicographically vs numerically, so "10" could come before "2" which would mess up assembly ordering.

Jules: that makes sense — the failed shard was a middle shard so lexicographic ordering could explain corrupted assembly. But why did the converter switch revisions after the checksum? it seemed to retry without the ?revision and hit latest.

Sasha: that's the fallback we added to try latest when a pinned rev 404s, but we never guarded that path for checksum errors. so if a shard checksum fails we should fail the job instead of retrying with latest. filing an issue now.

Henry: small addendum: the weight key mismatch looked like HF's safetensors metadata flagged a different key layout (e.g., "module.model.embed_tokens" vs our expected "model.wte"). the converter has a key-rename map for common renames but this variant wasn't covered. could be an arch variant or an export tool difference.

Arun: Proposed action items: 1) verify index and all shard checksums client-side before any retry; 2) preserve the revision param on retries (no silent falling back to latest on checksum errors); 3) sort shard entries numerically when reconstructing; 4) extend key-rename heuristics and add a shape-based fallback with warnings (don't auto-swap without explicit mapping). anyone object?

Marta: +1. also add an automated regression test: craft an index with out-of-order entries and a corrupt shard to assert we fail-fast and don't re-resolve revision.

infra-bot: Created issue #INF-4321: "converter: fail-fast on shard checksum mismatch; preserve revision on retries; numeric shard sort; expand key-rename heuristics" — assigned to eng-ml.

Jules: thanks all. quick workaround: re-uploaded the shards on HF with verified checksums and re-ran converter with `--strict-checks --revision=v2.1-quant` and the conversion completed. i'll attach the failing index.json and shard file to the INF-4321 issue for postmortem. :thumbsup:
